resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county list gives 81 feet for the 1930 ladder tower. A 1947 survey note in the same entry says about 100 feet. The record uses the list figure; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Build facts (1930, 81 ft, tower 31, southeast of Big Fork) come from the Itasca county list and the statewide A-Z list, which agree. Gone status rests on the FFLA county list with no date. The Forest Lookouts page for Link Lake (centraluslookouts.weebly.com) gives only the name and county, so it is not cited. No staffing, fire, removal or current-site sources found. Access and visit fields left out. Two searches used. No photos added.
